Question 4
?

Which of the following is equivalent to the integral ∫C2x3yds, where C is the section of the curve y=1x between the points (1,1) and (2,12)?

a
2∫12tt2+1dt
b
 2∫12t2t4+1dt
c
 ∫12t4t2+1dt
d
2∫12t4+1dt
e
 ∫12tt2+2dt
